stratum_name: teacher over-constraint probe (all X, OPEN and CLOSED instances exist)

curriculum.name: all_requests_by
curriculum.goal: Given a person, return all the requests that person made, whether open or closed.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE all_requests_by(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND REQUEST WHERE SELF.WHO={person}
RETURN $v0
END
